# Vanterm

> VANTERM (Gebze, Kocaeli, Turkey) has designed and manufactured industrial dust collectors, fume extractors and filtration systems since 1971: mobile and central filter units, extraction arms, workbenches and cutting tables for welding, laser/plasma cutting, grinding, sandblasting and woodworking. The site is bilingual (English at /, Turkish at /tr/).

Contact: bilgi@vanterm.com · +90 262 751 05 94 · https://vanterm.com/contact-us/

## Products

- [AC Central Extraction Units](https://vanterm.com/product/ac-central-extraction-units/): AC – filter units are designed as a central extraction and filtration solution for mainly metal working industries.
- [Bespoke Dust Collectors – Filter Units for OEM](https://vanterm.com/product/bespoke-dust-collectors-filter-units-for-oem/)
- [BG Series Filter Units](https://vanterm.com/product/bg-series-filter-units/): BG – mobile filter unit is designed as a compact solution for filtration needs of dry dust and particles, generated during various industrial operations.
- [Cutting Tables for Plasma](https://vanterm.com/product/cutting-tables-for-plasma/): VANTERM cutting tables are designed for CNC plasma and OXY cutting operations. The main design feature is their flexibility.
- [Cyclones](https://vanterm.com/product/cyclones/)
- [ECO Series Filter Units](https://vanterm.com/product/eco-series-filter-units/): ECO – mobile filter unit is designed as a perfect economic solution for filtration needs in welding shops.
- [EK – Extraction Arms](https://vanterm.com/product/ek-extraction-arms/): EK – series extraction arms are used for providing a flexible and an effective exhaust from the workplace.
- [ESP-600 Electrostatic Precipitators](https://vanterm.com/product/esp-600-electrostatic-precipitators/): ESP-600 electrostatic precipitators are used to filter the sticky-greasy dust, smoke and odor emissions in the textile industry.
- [HV High Vacuum Filter Units](https://vanterm.com/product/hv-high-vacuum-filter-units/): HV – filter units are designed for extraction and filtration of dust-smoke and particles, where there is a demand for high extraction velocity.
- [KAB Series Filter Units](https://vanterm.com/product/kab-series-filter-units/): KAB filter units are produced for filtration of welding dust and smoke. Thanks to its compact design, it fits easily in any welding-shops in factory halls.
- [KAB – Vortex Filter Units](https://vanterm.com/product/kab-vortex-filter-units/)
- [KO – Extension Cranes](https://vanterm.com/product/ko-extension-cranes/): Extension cranes are used together with the extraction arms, in order to extend the range of the arms.
- [KTM – Workbenches](https://vanterm.com/product/ktm-workbenches/): KTM-Series workstations are designed to serve both as filter unit and as workbench for metal working industries.
- [M Series Filter Units](https://vanterm.com/product/m-series-filter-units/): M – Series mobile filter unit is designed for filtration of smoke and odor in different industrial processes.
- [MD – Modular Hoods](https://vanterm.com/product/md-modular-hoods/)
- [PC-02 Precoating Unit](https://vanterm.com/product/pc-precoating-unit/)
- [PL Series Dust Collectors for Plasma&Laser](https://vanterm.com/product/pl-series-dust-collectors-for-plasma-laser/): PL – Plasma Laser filter units are designed and produced for filtration of dust, fume and smoke, generated during CNC Laser- and Plasma-cutting operations.
- [PM Series Filter Units](https://vanterm.com/product/pm-series-filter-units/): PM – mobile filter units are ideal solutions for filtration needs in welding shops. With its lightweight, easy to move in the welding shop.
- [SM Series Filter Units](https://vanterm.com/product/sm-series-filter-units/): SM – filter units are designed for dedusting of dry dust and particles, generated during various industrial operations.
- [T – Series Workbenches](https://vanterm.com/product/t-series-workbenches/): T-series workbenches are ideal solution for manual grinding processes. The sidewalls are opened easily, which enable to work with bigger parts.
- [Ventilators in Silencer Box](https://vanterm.com/product/ventilators-in-silencer-box/)
- [VR – Wall Mounted Fan](https://vanterm.com/product/vr-wall-mounted-fan/): VR model wall-mounted fan is designed to use together with extraction arm or extension crane.
- [Water Pre-Separator](https://vanterm.com/product/water-pre-separator/): The water pre-separator is designed as a complimentary accessory which is integrated to the selected VANTERM filter unit, on request.

## Product categories

- [Auxiliary Equipments](https://vanterm.com/portfolio-category/auxiliary-equipments/): VANTERM provides supplementary accessories that are necessary to install, to increase the effectiveness of the whole extraction system.
- [Bespoke Dust Collectors - Filter Units for OEM](https://vanterm.com/portfolio-category/bespoke-dust-collectors-filter-units-for-oem/): VANTERM, with its long-term experience in the field of industrial filtration, can provide you tailor-made solutions to meet high environmental standards.
- [Electrostatic Filter Units](https://vanterm.com/portfolio-category/electrostatic-filter-units/): Electrostatic filter units provides a high separation degree for sticky and greasy mist and used for the filtration of exhaust gas from the stenter machines
- [Extraction Arms - Extension Cranes and Fans](https://vanterm.com/portfolio-category/extraction-arms-extension-cranes-and-fans/): New model VANTERM extraction arms with low pressure loss, enable great electrical power savings for the central extraction systems via duct pipelines.
- [Filter Towers](https://vanterm.com/portfolio-category/filter-towers/): Filter towers are used as an ideal solution for hall ventilation and mostly used in production halls with light dust pollution problem or in welding shops.
- [Mobile Filter Units](https://vanterm.com/portfolio-category/mobile-filter-units/): VANTERM mobile filter units are used for extraction of welding fumes, dry dust and odor containing smoke and particles.
- [Spark Separtors & Cyclones](https://vanterm.com/portfolio-category/spark-separtors-cyclones/): The spark separators, cyclones or pre-filters at today’s high speed production become indispensable for some of the industrial dust collecting systems.
- [Stationary and Central Filter Units](https://vanterm.com/portfolio-category/stationary-and-central-filter-units/)
- [Workbenches & Cutting Tables](https://vanterm.com/portfolio-category/workbenches-cutting-tables/): Today, production halls are dynamic and fast lay-out changes are inevitable. VANTERM KTM series workbenches are the ideal solution for such needs.
